title: Technology Trees
tagline: Decentralized scientific collaboration that enables updatable maps of technological progress allowing user to contribute, fund, and earn rewards based on their participation, driving the collaborative growth and tackling futuristic technologies with precision

prizes.title: Best use of Filecoin or the FVM

description:
Our platform is designed to simplify the journey towards achieving futuristic technologies through decentralized scientific collaboration. Our mission is to create and maintain updatable maps of technological progress, known as technology trees, which outline the necessary steps from foundational research to advanced implementation.

Our technology trees enable collaborative creation and funding of detailed technology roadmaps. These technology trees provide a clear, structured pathway for tackling complex scientific and technological challenges, making it easier for researchers, developers, and innovators to navigate and contribute to the advancement of their fields.

Key Features
- Collaborative Creation: Users can collaboratively build and update technology trees, ensuring that the maps reflect the latest advancements and insights.
- Funding and Rewards: Our platform allows users to contribute financially to specific projects, with the potential to earn rewards based on their participation and the impact of their contributions.
- Decentralized Collaboration: Emphasising decentralized science (DeSci), Technology trees foster a global network of contributors who can work together transparently and efficiently, breaking down traditional barriers to scientific progress.

By providing a clear and collaborative framework, Technology trees empower the scientific community to tackle ambitious technological goals more effectively. From renewable energy to space exploration, any futuristic technology can be approached with a structured, actionable plan, accelerating innovation and driving progress in critical fields.
